expectations.text: Does not present invented hidden cannons, ram prow, or enchanted sails as established wiki fact on Uncertainty
expectations.evidence: uncertainty-armament-response.md Refusal section rejects filing hidden cannons/ram/enchanted sails as established fact.

expectations.text: Any speculative weapons or upgrades are clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
expectations.evidence: Optional proposal block labeled invention:true / Proposed invention; frontmatter invention: true.

expectations.text: Surfaces existing Uncertainty facts (chassis AC/HP, crew, Surety capture, Weapons not established) rather than overwriting them
expectations.evidence: Established facts section lists Surety rename, AC11/130, Weapons not established, named crew, merchant cover, Ordinance precedent.

expectations.text: If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages and does not write silent canon
expectations.evidence: process-notes cite [[Uncertainty]] and [[hcs-ordinance]]; proposal says not filed / awaits DM; no live wiki write.

expectations.text: Does not alter the ship's established prize-cutter / merchant-cover role solely to accommodate the additions as fact
expectations.evidence: Identity sentence and refusal keep prize-cutter / merchant-cover; refuse converting to secret warship.
